description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the ReportingMethodConfigurationDao class within the OrangeHRM PIM Plugin. It verifies CRUD operations, list retrieval, count, delete functionality, and checking for existing reporting method names.

classes.name: ReportingMethodConfigurationDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing ReportingMethodConfigurationDao methods, including add, edit, fetch, list, count, delete, and existence check.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DAO object and populates test data before each test.

methods.name: testAddReportingMethod
methods.description: Tests adding a new ReportingMethod and verifies it is saved correctly.

methods.name: testEditReportingMethod
methods.description: Tests editing an existing ReportingMethod and verifies the updates are saved.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodById
methods.description: Verifies fetching a ReportingMethod by its ID returns the correct object.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodList
methods.description: Checks retrieving a list of ReportingMethods with default filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodListWithLimit
methods.description: Tests fetching a limited list of ReportingMethods.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodCount
methods.description: Verifies the count of ReportingMethods matches expectations.

methods.name: testDeleteReportingMethods
methods.description: Tests deleting multiple ReportingMethods by IDs.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Verifies behavior when attempting to delete non-existing ReportingMethods.

methods.name: testIsExistingReportingMethodName
methods.description: Checks if various case and whitespace variations of a name are recognized as existing.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodByName
methods.description: Tests fetching a ReportingMethod by its name with different case and whitespace variations and verifies non-existing names.
